## Summary of Los Angeles on Google Maps

### 📍 Task Completion Status
1. ✅ **Navigated to Google Maps** (https://www.google.com/maps/)
2. ✅ **Searched for Los Angeles** — Successfully loaded the correct location: Los Angeles, California, USA at coordinates 34.052235°N, 118.243683°W
3. ⚠️ **Attempted to print the map as PDF** — Invoked `window.print()` through JavaScript. In a headless/automated browser environment, the system print dialog cannot be physically displayed or saved directly to a PDF file. To print as PDF in a real browser, the user would press Ctrl+P (or ⌘+P on Mac) and select "Save as PDF" as the destination.
4. ✅ **Summarized map information** (see below)

### 🗺️ Los Angeles — Map Information

**Basic Facts (from Wikipedia, shown in the sidebar):**
- **Name:** Los Angeles (洛杉矶)
- **Location:** Southern California, United States (美国 / 加利福尼亚)
- **Type:** Major city and county seat of Los Angeles County
- **Population:** Approximately **3.97 million**
- **Area:** **469.1 square miles**
- **Rank:** 
  - Largest city in California (加州第一大城市)
  - 2nd largest metropolitan area in the U.S. (only after New York City)
  - Not the state capital of California

**Map View (Captured Visually):**
- **Center:** Downtown Los Angeles (洛杉矶市中心)
- **Zoom scale:** 5 km
- **Map data:** © 2026 Google
- **Map type:** Standard map

**Major Cities/Neighborhoods Visible on the Map:**
- Los Angeles (central) • Burbank (伯班克) • Pasadena (帕萨迪纳)
- Glendale area • Long Beach (near LGB Airport) • Compton
- Santa Monica/Westside • Hollywood • Monterey Park • Alhambra
- Arcadia/Duarte/Sierra Madre • El Monte • West Covina
- Fullerton • Brea • La Habra • Whittier • Norwalk • Lakewood
- Montebello • Rosemead • Diamond Bar • Walnut • City of Industry
- South Gate • Huntington Park • Bell Gardens

**Major Highways Visible:**
- Interstate 5 (I-5), I-10, I-110, I-210, I-605, I-710
- US Route 101 (Hollywood Fwy)
- State Routes 2, 39, 47, 57, 60, 72, 91

**Famous Landmarks on the Map:**
- 🌟 **Universal Studios Hollywood** (north of central LA)
- 🌟 **Disneyland Park** (south, in Anaheim area)
- LGB (Long Beach Airport)

**Available Action Buttons in Sidebar:**
- Directions (路线) • Save (保存) • Nearby (附近) • Send to phone (发送到手机) • Share (分享)

**Search Filters Available:**
- Restaurants (餐厅) • Hotels (酒店) • Recommended activities (推荐活动) • Museums (博物馆) • Public transportation (公共交通) • Pharmacies (药店) • ATMs (自动取款机)

### ⚠️ Note on PDF Printing
In this automated browser environment, the system print dialog cannot be opened interactively, so the PDF could not be saved to disk from within this session. To print the map as a PDF in a real browser session, open the page and press **Ctrl+P** (Windows/Linux) or **⌘+P** (Mac), then choose **"Save as PDF"** as the printer destination. The map, title, and Wikipedia summary will all be included in the PDF output.
